correctness.rationale: All face and chain calculations from the standalone final package: 5888 augmented faces, 23160 signed Hasse incidences, 2889 acyclic matching pairs leaving 87 critical 3-cells and 23 critical 4-cells; full integer Smith matrix has twenty-two ones and one three, with a 23x23 exact determinant -3 and a mod-three rank of 22. A direct fixed-face signed Lefschetz computation for all 120 graph automorphisms gives rational characters (64,0,-2,-1) on rotation orders 1,2,3,5 and (16,0,-2,1) after antipodal inversion, giving the stated A5 constituents. A reconstructed mod-three 4-cycle with 1009 terms, boundary checked on all 3-faces, plus commuting chain projection on all 1482 4-faces, gives the order-three torsion sign action via natural UCT. This determines the stated finite object exactly and makes no inference to other graphs.

value.rationale: The exact graph has a 120-symmetry icosahedral group and a previously established three-torsion homology class; its induced actions are natural invariants not fixed by nonequivariant homotopy. The exact rational decomposition provides the otherwise unknown 40/24 antipodal split and irreducible A5 content; the torsion line carries a genuinely nontrivial antipodal sign and trivial rotation action. This is a complete natural equivariant classification of selected homology coefficients for a central polyhedral example, not a routine conversion of known Betti numbers. No larger family is asserted.
